column1: • Consuming a wide variety of vegetables, berries and fruits – at least 500
to 800 grams per day, which correspond to about five to nine servings–*,
• About  half  of  the  recommended  amount  should  be  vegetables  and  root
vegetables, and the rest should be berries and fruits. These are recommended
to be consumed uncooked, cooked and as ingredients for various foods.
• Frozen vegetables and berries are good alternatives**.
